stem: (Select TWO.) A platform group compares HCP Terraform execution modes before choosing one per workspace. Which two statements are correct?

choices.text: Agent mode lets HCP Terraform run Terraform on lightweight agents inside a private network
Local mode keeps the state on the workstation, and HCP Terraform stores none of it
Remote mode runs Terraform on the engineer's workstation and keeps the state in HCP Terraform
Remote mode is the only choice for runs that need to reach private, on-premises systems
Local mode leaves variables and variable sets unevaluated by HCP Terraform

rationale: Agent mode lets HCP Terraform communicate with lightweight agents so Terraform runs in isolated, private or on-premises infrastructure. In Local mode runs happen on the workstation, and HCP Terraform does not evaluate workspace variables or variable sets. HCP Terraform still stores the state in Local mode, since the workspace acts as a remote backend for state. Remote mode runs on HCP Terraform's own disposable virtual machines rather than on a workstation. Reaching private or on-premises systems is the purpose of Agent mode, so Remote is not the only choice for that need.
